entities.summary: Marco Chiudinelli is a retired tennis player from Switzerland. A member of Switzerland's winning 2014 Davis Cup squad, he reached his highest singles ranking of 52 in February 2010 during a career that was often hindered by injury. Marco Chiudinelli was a athletes & competitors from Basel (b. 1981-09-10, Basel). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
